settled.line: geodesic: the shortest path over the surface (Q4)
settled.offLand: nothing happens; the line tool keeps waiting (Q5)
settled.visibility: an adventurer sees the shop's seeded expeditions and their own; signed out, seeded only (Q6)
settled.samePlace: two points closer than the tolerance are the same place (Q11)

seededExpeditions.name: Cairn to Shoals
seededExpeditions.note: On the far side of the globe from the default view, centred over Moonwell Spring.

criteria.given: the shop publishes the eight reagent sites of Aurelis
criteria.when: an adventurer opens the reagent map
criteria.then: all eight sites are listed, and each is shown within 1 km of its published position

criteria.given: Frostcap Hollow lies near the north pole and Tidewrack Shoals on the 180th meridian
criteria.when: the adventurer turns the globe to each of them
criteria.then: each is shown at its position, neither clipped nor repeated
exactly the three seeded expeditions are shown, each with both ends within 1 km of its seeded sites

criteria.given: Elara is signed in and has saved one expedition, and Borin has saved another
criteria.then: the three seeded expeditions and Elara's expedition are shown, and Borin's is not

criteria.given: the default view, in which Tidewrack Shoals is on the far side of the globe
criteria.when: the adventurer flies to Tidewrack Shoals
criteria.then: Tidewrack Shoals is on screen, on the near side of the globe

criteria.given: the adventurer has started a line
criteria.when: they place a point at Moonwell Spring and a second point at Ember Crag
criteria.then: a completed line joins the two points, and it can be saved

criteria.given: the adventurer has started a line and placed one point
criteria.when: no second point has been placed
criteria.then: no line is complete and it cannot be saved

criteria.given: a completed line from Thornveil Glade to Glimmerdeep Caves
criteria.then: it follows the shortest path over the surface of Aurelis between them, not a straight line on a flat map

criteria.given: the adventurer has started a line
criteria.when: they try to place a point on space beside the globe
criteria.then: no point is placed and the line tool is still waiting for its first point

criteria.given: the adventurer has started a line
criteria.when: they try to place a point on the edge of the globe, where the land faces away
she draws a line from Moonwell Spring to Ember Crag, saves it, and opens the reagent map again
criteria.then: her new expedition is shown, and the shop holds it for Elara with both ends within 1 km of where she placed them

criteria.given: no adventurer is signed in and a completed line is on the map
criteria.then: they are asked to sign in, and the shop holds no new expedition

criteria.given: Elara is signed in and has placed both points less than 1 km apart
criteria.when: she tries to save the line
criteria.then: the save is refused as a zero-length line, and the shop holds no new expedition

criteria.given: Elara has placed one point of a line
criteria.then: the new line has no points, and the shop holds no new expedition

criteria.given: Elara has drawn a line without saving it
criteria.when: she leaves the reagent map and opens it again
criteria.then: the unsaved line is not shown, and the shop holds no new expedition

critique.finding: AC8 was marked observable via both; the shop holds only the two endpoints, so whether the line is geodesic is visible only in how it is drawn.
AC1 'listed' depends on H5 (sites listed beside the globe); kept, since H5 was accepted.
No criterion says what a signed-out adventurer sees while drawing (H3: they can draw). AC12 covers the save; drawing itself is covered by AC6 regardless of sign-in.
